note: CMS schema for the LastPass support portal page types, organized the way an editor fills them in. Field types use the lastpass_cms manifest vocabulary (tools/schema-gen.mjs turns manifests into Schema Designer XDR) and groups follow docs/spec/field-groups.json (collapsible blocks in the edit form). Each field: name (stable element name), label (what the editor sees), type, required, help, and optional values/default/max. categories are CMS taxonomy tags on the page or tray; trays is the page's Page Builder area. Covers only the net-new work: the Flex page, three special page types, five trays and four components. The header, footer, article, search and other built pages are out of scope. Drives the schema tabs in components.html and the CMS schema panel on every page.

topic-billing.html.label: Topic overview, utility
trays: link lists, notice, table, On this page

scope.hero: Builds on the hero and search band already built for the home page: adds layout, style and the media slot.
scope.cards: Builds on the Featured Documentation cards already built: adds card styles, columns and cards from a guide.
scope.FAQ item: New. A shared library of questions.
scope.Notice: New for authors; uses the DITA note style already built.

element_rule: As tools/schema-gen.mjs writes them: rich xhtml_Name, image xpowerasset_Name, link xpowerlink_Name, component xpowercomponent_Name, lists xpowerlist_ + plural (Name + s, or Name + List when it already ends in s); other types keep the name.
